mechanisms.decisive_claim: For fixed total unit T, the complete leaf profile Psi(j)=(phi_j,alpha_j) has exactly the same fibres and range cardinality as phi_j.
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove alpha_j=T-phi_j and construct the inverse graph map.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The four product-unit observables provide two or more independent leaf-varying profile coordinates after fixing the common total spectrum.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: Least-support normalization in an ordered torsion-free Gamma is multiplicative and yields phi_j=v(P_{lambda_j X}).
mechanisms.kill_test: Prove v(PQ)=v(P)+v(Q), including the no-cancellation leading term.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: The cardinality of the raw absolute-unit profile range is invariant under independent choices of normalized representatives for distinct associate classes.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For the natural minimum-support profile on a same-sign class, phi_j equals lambda_j times the relevant fixed endpoint; it is injective exactly when that endpoint is nonzero.
mechanisms.kill_test: Use distinct lambda_j and torsion-freeness to test equality of two phi values.

mechanisms.decisive_claim: For the fixed natural order, every same-sign class obeys an exact dichotomy: relevant endpoint zero gives profile range one, while relevant endpoint nonzero gives an injective profile.
mechanisms.kill_test: Keep the natural order fixed and split on whether the sign-relevant endpoint is zero.

mechanisms.kill_test: Combine the exact fibre interface with scalar-copy injectivity on the actual selected family.
